thread:
anika: quick follow-up from the Quota Interface consolidation RFC — compiling the migration plan, risk points, and a few open tradeoffs.
julian: can you call out the compatibility guarantee we promised Dedicated customers? need to make sure legal/ops are aligned.
maya: tl;dr: preserve per-tenant token semantics, keep a short-lived LeaseAPI shim, opt-in strict ledger mode for new tenants.
liam: main operational risk is double-counting if requests are routed to old and new ledgers during rollout.
anika: mitigation proposal: 2-week gradual rollout with a shim that emits mapping headers and runtime-level dedupe by request-id. header example: X-Quota-Map: lease-v1=>ledger-v2;shim=anika-2024
julian: show the dedupe behavior in pseudo, ops wants something they can implement quickly.
anika: pseudocode:
```
if req.headers.contains("X-Quota-Map"):
  if seen(req.id): return ACCEPTED_NO_CHARGE
  else: mark_seen(req.id); forward_to_ledger()
else:
  forward_to_legacy()
```
liam: what about the partial-failure case where legacy returns success and ledger times out? could cause under/over charging.
maya: legacy remains authoritative for the migration window. ledger writes are best-effort and reconciled later. reconciliation job surfaces mismatches; we alert on >0.1% drift.
julian: reconciliation cadence and SLOs?
anika: initial daily recon job, P1 alert if mismatch >0.1% for 24h. long-term: continuous streaming reconciler (post-migration).
liam: abuse vectors — clients switching endpoints to evade throttles. how do we catch cross-path abuse?
anika: add a cross-path abuse detector in ingress that fingerprints clients and keeps a sketch counter across paths. rule: if client QPS > 3x baseline while burst credits disabled => soft-block + alert.
maya: ledger needs to surface per-request abuse telemetry so ingress can act. field: abuse_score in response metadata.
anika: ledger will return header X-Quota-Abuse: <0-100>. ingress routes score>60 to probation pool.
julian: SDK churn concerns — do we force SDK updates for these headers?
anika: no. headers are optional; SDKs can surface but not required. Console and telemetry will show trends.
liam: ops-bot, schedule a canary rollout for the shim in prod-stable-noncritical cluster next Tue.
ops-bot: scheduled canary: prod-stable-noncritical on 2024-11-12T08:30Z. watchers: @eng-infra, @oncall. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: canary started on prod-stable-noncritical @ 2024-11-12T08:30Z — build r2024.11.12-shim. logs: https://deploys/redwood/canary/1749991234
maya: telemetry fields to add to quota events: ledger_version, shim_id, request_id, abuse_score, reconciled
anika: add dedupe_rate metric too so we can measure how often requests hit both paths.
julian: public-facing SLA note for Dedicated: any breaking window?
anika: no breaking. LeaseAPI deprecated 90 days after tenant reaches 100% ledger adoption. deprecation will have email, console banner, and automated migration assist.
liam: emergency rollback plan if reconciliation shows >1% undercharging?
anika: rollback toggles: shim.pass_through=true to route to legacy-only, pause-ledger-ingest flag. playbook entries will be added.
maya: I'll draft the runbook snippet for oncall with steps to flip toggles and escalate.
anika: thanks. I'll update the RFC with exact headers, timeline, reconciler SLOs, and canary observability checklist. ping here when the canary runs so we can watch dedupe_rate and abuse_score drift. :eyes:
julian: cool, thanks everyone.
